scores.reasons: Gap: broken contact link and broken mobile layout on a large firm's site. Pay: 175+ staff, federal/foundation contracts. Ease: Wix build and a bigger organisation means approvals, but the top fixes are small. Evidence: about, contact, robots and Maps inspected directly.

caveats: Google Maps was opened in a real browser but returns a 'limited view' - star ratings are shown, but review counts are not displayed for any business in this batch, so review volume is reported as 'count not displayed'.
This batch is almost entirely B2B professional services; several firms have little or no consumer review base, so absence of reviews is normal for the segment rather than a failure.
Assessment of ability_to_pay is based on published staff counts, office footprints and client mix only; no financial information was reviewed.

Judgements about internal operations (manual triage, proposal effort, after-hours call handling) are inferences drawn from what the website does and does not offer, and are labelled as such in the operations_signals fields.
data_gaps: VFS Environmental: vfsenvironmental.com returned HTTP 502 and the https endpoint timed out on repeated attempts; I could not view any of the firm's own content. Current operating status rests on a January 2026 municipal appointment document.

McSweeney Engineering: the site is served only over http and Chrome refused to load it (TLS connection refused, plain HTTP blocked in the browser). Website review is based on the raw HTML fetched directly, so no phone-width screenshot was possible.

Winton Group Architecture: could not verify recent trading activity - the domain is parked, the Google listing is unclaimed, and the most recent evidence found is permit and directory records. Status is set to operating on the strength of the live listing and phone number only.
MSC Associates: the company does not state what it sells anywhere on its site, and search results do not clarify its services; nothing about its size, staff or client base could be confirmed.
Review counts for every listing could not be read (Google's limited-view map layout), and no Yelp/BBB review pages were reviewed for this batch.
